plugin.canonical_name: Hit it, Joe! (Formerly TF2-ish Critical Hits Plugin)

variant.author: Berna, kai, Kiri
variant.description:
* Set sounds and flavor text to be played/shown whenever you deal direct or critical damage or heal.
* Set sounds to be played when a countdown is in progress.
* Use different configurations by job.
* Use the game's SFX or your own custom WAV or MP3 files.
variant.name: Hit it, Joe! (Formerly TF2-ish Critical Hits Plugin)
variant.punchline: Configure sounds for critical and direct hits, plus some countdown music.
